physical.label: Shooting luck
physical.text: Pacers have been unlucky from three lately: about 3.8 points a game below league-average shooting (theirs and their opponents').
physical.means: per point a game the team (and its opponents) shot threes above or below league average lately; luck does not last

reasoning: On the season so far the Pacers are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 2 points better, in a game of about 240 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Bulls win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 213 and 262 total points.
